371:t_3:32.en:
$n
「That's right. It's a shame I didn't get to eat $$谷川$$'s special pork soup.」

371:t_3:33.en:
$$谷川$$
「Well, well, $n. If that's how you felt, you should have just said so sooner.」

371:t_3:35.en:
$$谷川$$
「'I want to eat your pork soup'... That's kind of a curveball proposal.」

371:t_3:37.en:
$$中原$$
「$n, you really do go for older women, don't you.」

371:t_3:38.en:
$$入江$$
「But proposing out of the blue is way too bo~ld.」

371:t_3:40.en:
$$谷川$$
「But sorry, $n. Unless you settle things with Miss $$スズネ$$ first, I can't accept your feelings.」

371:t_3:41.en:
$$大山$$
「It's no use, $$谷川$$. $n is totally spaced out and isn't listening.」

371:t_3:42.en:
$$トッポ$$
「Well then, we'll just eat the ohagi ourselves!」

371:t_3:46.en:
$$ティティ$$
「I'm $$ティティ$$. ...Excuse me... could I have some tea?」

371:t_3:48.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Haa... This is sweet and delicious.」

371:t_3:52.en:
$n
「$$ティティ$$...! Why are you here?」

371:t_3:55.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Yeah... It looked like it would be fun, so I... followed you here.」

371:t_10:5.en:
$n
「...It's nothing much. Once I've rested a bit, I'll get back to the special training.」

371:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Aren't you making progress little by little? You held your own well enough in the $$ジェニオン$$, too.」

371:t_10:7.en:
$n
「It's driven home to me how much I'd been relying on Miss $$スズネ$$ until now.」

371:t_10:8.en:
$n
「The $$ジェニオン$$ is a single-seater to begin with, so I have to be able to manage in that state.」

371:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now that you mention it, that's true. I'd gotten so used to it carrying two that I'd completely forgotten.」

371:t_10:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「However, $n, having fought it out in the $$ジェニオン$$, you produced $$Ｚチップ$$ worth 50 Z. I'll add them to the unit's stock.」

371:t_10:11.en:
$n
「I feel like I'm about to grasp something... That hope must be what produced the $$Ｚチップ$$.」

371:t_10:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh... In that case, to keep the balance, shall I give you some despair as well?」

371:t_10:13.en:
$n
「I'll pass. I've got a big enough headache over the stowaway as it is.」

371:t_10:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(That took $n's mind off it a little, at least, which is a relief.)

371:t_10:15.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(But the original $$ジェニオン$$, hmm... An intriguing thing to say.)

371:t_10:21.en:
$$勝平$$
「W-What, AG? Grinning like that, it's creepy...」

371:t_10:22.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Mr. $$ワッ太$$ was complaining, you know. He thought Mr. $$勝平$$ would finally introduce him to some girlfriends... he said.」

371:t_10:23.en:
$$勝平$$
「Forget about the $$ブスペア$$, all right!」

371:t_10:24.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$$ブスペア$$... That's a cruel nickname for girls that age.」

371:t_10:25.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Or is it that thing? The one boys that age tend to do, where you tease the ones you like the most~?」

371:t_10:31.en:
$$勝平$$
「AG... I'm crazy about you, too. I can't stand it.」

371:t_10:33.en:
$$勝平$$
「So, that being the case, I'm gonna tease you as much as I want! Do it, $$千代錦$$!」

371:t_10:37.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah, stop it! If you pee on me, my body will rust!」

371:t_10:39.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「...At this rate, AG won't be able to come back over here for a while.」

371:t_10:40.en:
$$恵子$$
「Then shall we take care of the shop, you and I?」

371:t_10:43.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「It's not that, but I'm not really used to this kind of thing.」

371:t_10:44.en:
$$恵子$$
「I guess not. With $$勝平$$ being so loud on our team, we hardly ever stand out.」

371:t_10:45.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「Since we've got the chance, let's cut loose! Let's go all out again today...!」

371:t_10:47.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「...Yelling at the top of your lungs feels surprisingly good.」

371:t_10:48.en:
$$恵子$$
「Next time, let's try shouting during $$ザンボット$$ Moon Attack too.」

372:t_000:0.en:
$$梅江$$
「T-There they are! Si... Si... Side...」

372:t_000:1.en:
$$花江$$
「It's the $$サイデリアル$$, Grandma!」

372:t_000:2.en:
$$市民$$
「Are they after this refugee camp!?」

372:t_000:3.en:
$$市民$$
「We have to get out of here fast!」

372:t_000:4.en:
$$梅江$$
「It's all right, everyone. $$ＺＥＵＴＨ$$ will come to help us right away.」

372:t_001:3.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「Well, he's got to protect the town where Auntie and the others are.」

372:t_001:4.en:
$$勝平$$
「...Watch me, $$ワッ太$$. The trash pickup didn't settle things, but here I'll show you what I can do!」

372:t_001:5.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「It's hopeless... He's fighting purely out of personal feelings...」

372:t_001:6.en:
$$万丈$$
「The enemy vanguard is charging the town. We must not let them through, no matter what.」
